# War Games

> Free open-source AI strategy game. NATO, Russia and China, each commanded by Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT, fight for global dominance on a live map.

## Pages

- [Home](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/WarGames/): overview, FAQ
- [How War Games works](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/WarGames/how-it-works/): How the War Games engine runs a turn: faction briefings, nine order types, combat, an AI news narrator, and cost controls that cap a game at 80 calls.
- [Nuclear exchange rules](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/WarGames/nuclear-exchange/): How nuclear weapons resolve in War Games: the three-level nuclear research track, warhead costs, ICBM range, territory destruction and automatic second strike.
- [Claude vs Gemini vs ChatGPT in War Games](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/WarGames/ai-providers/): Run Claude, Gemini and GPT against each other as rival superpowers. How to pick a provider per faction, use local models, and keep costs low in War Games.
- [Modding War Games](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/WarGames/modding/): Change how War Games plays: edit the rules, the four-track tech tree, the starting world and each faction persona, and learn which numbers the engine enforces.
